edits.before: - Soraka Equinox: matchup-defining — The silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast — step out before the root snaps. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Overdrive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Equinox (E) is 20s at rank 1, down to 16s at rank 5 — the silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast, so step out before the root snaps. - Keep W Overdrive banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
